limitations: Exact finite homotopy type for the bidirected triangular prism only; no general classification for larger prisms, other orientations, or equivariant representations. A search cannot exclude unpublished equivalent results.
scientific_integrity: An exhaustive finite face-poset calculation, integral Morse boundary reduction, and rational cup-product obstruction check are supplied as executable code. The interpretation of the resulting data uses standard Hurewicz and Hilton-Milnor theory. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: The multipath complex of the bidirected triangular prism is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
